findings.claim: The generated comment tells readers to run `labdrian skill-registry refresh --force`, a verb that does not exist yet (the commit says nothing calls the package). A registry written from this package before the verb lands would point at a missing command.
The package doc cites a parity test in `engine/skillregistry/app`, which this change does not add. The reference is dangling until a later commit.

The table-end scan consumes every contiguous line starting with `| `. A Hermes or other foreign table placed directly under the rows with no blank line is silently dropped, unless its rows are `sdd-` rows. This contradicts the claim that every line outside the generated head and rows is kept byte for byte.

A plain description that starts with a quote and does not end with one (e.g. `"Use when x" for y`) is treated as an open quoted value. If indented lines follow, such as a nested mapping, and one ends with that quote character, they are merged into the description. Gentle-ai would keep only the first line.

evidence: Reviewed the full diff only; no tools were available.
Compose is idempotent on its own output, and foreignHead drops every generated head line, which the tests cover.
Row.Line escapes bars in the name and description but not backticks in the name or path (minor).
